query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as student_count,
  SUM(s.feePerQuarter) as total_quarterly_fee
FROM students s
LEFT JOIN dojos d ON s.venue = d.name
WHERE (d.coach_name = '賴政堡教練' OR s.venue IN ('寶林道場 ', '至善道場', '蒲崗村道場'))
  AND s.venue != '精英班道場';
